name: Implicit vs. Explicit Transfer Function (TF) Representation
definition: Implicit TF representation: Uses a preclassified volume to represent TF information. Makes the network invariant to input modality and helps generalize to different modalities, as only structures are unseen, not the general input scale. Easier learning task as the network doesn't need to learn TF application.
summary: Implicit TFs use pre-classified volumes for easier learning and modality invariance, while explicit TFs use raw parameters for efficiency and editability despite harder optimization.
